availability_zone.description: The available zone to launch ecs instance and other resources.

i18n.zh-Hans: 可用区用于启动ECS实例和其他资源。
i18n.en-US: The available zone to launch ECS instance and other resources.

image_id.description: The image id used to launch ecs instances. If not set, a system image with `image_name_regex` will be returned.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动ECS实例的镜像ID。如果没有设置，则返回带有`image_name_regex`的系统镜像。
i18n.en-US: The image id used to launch ECS instances. If not set, a system image with `image_name_regex` will be returned.

image_name_regex.description: The ECS image's name regex used to fetch specified image.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于获取指定镜像的ECS镜像名称正则表达式。
i18n.en-US: The ECS image's name regex used to fetch specified image.

instance_type.description: The instance type used to launch ecs instances. If not set, a random type with `cpu_core_count` and `memory_size` will be returned.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动ECS实例的实例类型。如果没有设置，将返回具有`cpu_core_count`和`memory_size`的随机类型。
i18n.en-US: The instance type used to launch ECS instances. If not set, a random type with the specified cpu_core_count and memory_size will be returned.

cpu_core_count.description: CPU core count used to fetch instance types.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于获取实例类型的CPU核心数。
i18n.en-US: CPU core count used to fetch instance types.

memory_size.description: Memory size used to fetch instance types.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于获取实例类型的内存大小。
i18n.en-US: Memory size used to fetch instance types.

vswitch_id.description: The existing VSwitch ID. If not set, a new vswitch will be created.

i18n.zh-Hans: 现有的VSwitch ID。如果没有设置，将创建一个新的vswitch。
i18n.en-US: The existing VSwitch ID. If not set, a new vswitch will be created.

security_group_ids.description: List of security group ids used to create ECS instances. If not set, a new one will be created.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于创建ECS实例的安全组ID列表。如果没有设置，将创建一个新的。
i18n.en-US: List of security group ids used to create ECS instances. If not set, a new one will be created.

key_name.description: The key pair name used to config instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于配置实例的密钥对名称。
i18n.en-US: The key pair name used to configure instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例的密码。
i18n.en-US: The password of instance.

instance_tags.description: Used to mark specified ecs instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于标记指定的ECS实例。
i18n.en-US: Used to mark specified ECS instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: ECS实例的数量。
i18n.en-US: The number of ECS instances.

user_data.description: User data to pass to instance on boot

i18n.zh-Hans: 引导时传递给实例的用户数据
i18n.en-US: User data to pass to instance on boot

vpc_id.description: The vpc id used to launch ecs instances. If not set, will create a new one.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动ECS实例的VPC ID。如果未设置，将创建一个新的。
i18n.en-US: The VPC ID used to launch ECS instances. If not set, will create a new one.

vswtich_id.description: The vswitch id used to launch ecs instances. If not set, will create a new one.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动ECS实例的虚拟交换机ID。如果未设置，将创建一个新的。
i18n.en-US: The vswitch id used to launch ECS instances. If not set, will create a new one.

disk_category.description: The system disk category used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个ECS实例的系统盘类别。
i18n.en-US: The system disk category used to launch one or more ECS instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 模块描述的规范。
i18n.en-US: The specification of module description.

role_name.description: Instance RAM role name. The name is provided and maintained by RAM. You can use 'alibabacloudstack_ram_role' to create a new one.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例RAM角色名称。名称由RAM提供并维护。您可以使用'alibabacloudstack_ram_role'创建一个新的。
i18n.en-US: Instance RAM role name. The name is provided and maintained by RAM. You can use 'alibabacloudstack_ram_role' to create a new one.

host_name.description: Host name used on all instances as prefix. Like if the value is TF-ECS-Host-Name and then the final host name would be TF-ECS-Host-Name001, TF-ECS-Host-Name002 and so on.

i18n.zh-Hans: 在所有实例中用作前缀的主机名。例如，如果值是TF-ECS-Host-Name，那么最终的主机名将是TF-ECS-Host-Name001、TF-ECS-Host-Name002等。
i18n.en-US: Host name used on all instances as prefix. For example, if the value is TF-ECS-Host-Name, then the final host names would be TF-ECS-Host-Name001, TF-ECS-Host-Name002, and so on.

kms_encrypted_password.description: An KMS encrypts password used to an instance. It is conflicted with 'password'.

i18n.zh-Hans: An KMS加密了用于实例的密码。它与'password'冲突。
i18n.en-US: An KMS encrypts password used for an instance. It conflicts with 'password'.

i18n.zh-Hans: 安全增强策略。
i18n.en-US: The security enhancement strategy.

tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要分配给资源的标签映射。
i18n.en-US: A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.

kms_encryption_context.description: An KMS encryption context used to decrypt 'kms_encrypted_password' before creating or updating an instance with 'kms_encrypted_password'.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于在创建或更新实例之前解密'kms_encrypted_password'的KMS加密上下文。
i18n.en-US: An KMS encryption context used to decrypt kms_encrypted_password before creating or updating an instance with kms_encrypted_password.

system_disk_size.description: The system disk size used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个ECS实例的系统盘大小。
i18n.en-US: The system disk size used to launch one or more ECS instances.
